field_name: Temporal Information Retrieval for Question Answering over Versioned Text

categories.name: Temporal Relevance Ranking Methods
categories.description: Methods that combine temporal relevance scores with semantic similarity to re-rank retrieved documents, often using gating functions or inverse time differences.

categories.name: Versioned Document Query Processing
categories.description: Techniques for querying versioned documents, such as temporal top-k queries, branch versioning management, and document listing over versioned collections.

categories.name: Surveys on Temporal/Multi-versioned XML
categories.description: Survey papers summarizing techniques for handling temporal and multi-versioned XML documents.

dominant_approaches: Temporal relevance scoring combined with semantic similarity
common_assumptions: Timestamps are available for queries and documents
Temporal relevance decreases with time difference
Semantic similarity from retrievers is a relevant signal

repeated_limitations.description: Limited to specific retriever types (e.g., dense only)
Evaluation on synthetic or narrow datasets
Lack of generalization to regulatory text
No consideration of dense semantic overlap across versions

underexplored_combinations: Retrieval-agnostic temporal relevance for open-domain QA over regulatory text
Handling dense semantic overlap across successive amendments
Benchmark with overlapping versioned regulatory documents and time-stamped queries

contradictions.description: Existing time-aware retrieval techniques treat each version as an isolated snapshot, making it difficult to distinguish which revision matches a time-specific query.
